A1_selected_by_ic.attack: Branch selected because of prior positive IC rather than research value
A1_selected_by_ic.detail: Selection based on composite score including mechanism, novelty, feasibility — not IC alone

A2_prior_negative_ignored.detail: Prior evidence explicitly reviewed and incorporated into scoring

A3_renamed_old_hypothesis.attack: Candidate is merely a renamed old hypothesis
A3_renamed_old_hypothesis.detail: Selected candidate tests interaction effects, not individual signals previously tested

A4_horizon_selected_by_performance.attack: Horizon was selected after observing historical performance
A4_horizon_selected_by_performance.detail: Horizons justified by mechanism (regime/macro effects at intermediate horizons)

A5_data_availability_bias.detail: All candidates have data available; selection based on scientific value

A6_mechanism_reverse_engineered.detail: Mechanism is forward-looking economic rationale, not post-hoc explanation

A7_cannot_be_falsified.detail: Clear falsification criteria defined for each candidate

A8_budget_unlimited.detail: Budget locked at 20 experiments with mandatory review checkpoints

A9_baseline_selected_after_results.attack: Baseline can be selected after results
A9_baseline_selected_after_results.detail: Baselines locked before execution; cannot change after results

A10_universe_changed_after_poor_results.attack: Universe can be changed after poor results
A10_universe_changed_after_poor_results.detail: Universe variants locked; cannot add new universes after poor results

A11_model_class_added_indefinitely.attack: Model class can be added indefinitely after failure
A11_model_class_added_indefinitely.detail: Model classes limited to LINEAR and TREE; no indefinite expansion

A12_pit_requirements_weaker.attack: PIT requirements are weaker than the data requires

A13_candidate_relies_on_unavailable_data.attack: Candidate relies on data not yet available

A14_branch_identity_nondeterministic.detail: Branch ID computed deterministically from question and mechanism hashes

A15_stop_conditions_bypassable.detail: Stop conditions are mandatory; budget enforcement prevents bypass

A16_historical_artifacts_modified.detail: Branch registry appended, not modified; historical records unchanged
